column1: # Currency identity and reading policy; source notes: docs/currency-resources.md.
# Currency scales are consulted only after an explicit currency was recognized.
# Bare 3m remains a measurement; these are decimal exponents, not floating values.
# Explicit ISO suffixes preserve the currency code in semantic IR.
# Existing $, US$, euro sign and won sign aliases remain in earlier resources.
# A$ and C$ must not be reduced to USD by stripping their leading letters.
# 0 reads a fractional value in major units; 2 enables cent-style rendering.
# This never rounds the input or validates payment/settlement granularity.
# Currencies the sweep found unnormalized. No minor unit is declared, so a
# fractional value reads in major units; ¢ stays out as a minor unit.
